name: Trần Phú Night Market
kicker: The walking street behind 46 Trần Phú
summary: Night stalls behind 46 Trần Phú: walk the 137 m food street after dark for the beach-road evening. Entry is free. Fifty stalls are set out, sixteen of them food, with bánh căn, squid, shrimp, and chè among the bowls. The sand in front of the same number is the other half of the night.
getThere: Behind 46 Trần Phú. You are already on the beach road.
heroCaption: Stalls and the crowd on the night-market walking street
body: The walking street sits behind the 46 Trần Phú Cultural Center, on Trần Phú in Lộc Thọ. It runs 137 m. Entry is free. Fifty stalls line it, sixteen of them food: bún chả, chả cá, bánh căn, fried squid, breaded shrimp, ice cream, and chè.
Come after dark. The sand in front of Trần Phú is the other half of this evening.

figures.caption: The stalls along the same walking street
figures.alt: A closer view of night-market stalls and people

gettingThere: From a hotel on Trần Phú, walk to number 46 and take the street behind the cultural centre.

legs.heading: From the sand
legs.body: Step inland at 46 Trần Phú. The street is 137 m.

legs.heading: From the station
legs.body: The station is in the centre. The walking street is on Trần Phú.
